This page explains the batches of edits linked from their edit summaries as '''PEP coverage'''.

== What the edits are for ==
The aim is to make Wikidata's coverage of '''politically exposed persons''' (people who hold or held senior public office) more complete and better connected. The edits come in two kinds:

; Positions hierarchy
: Items for political positions (ministers, members of parliament, judges, mayors, heads of state agencies and the like) often lack the statements that place them: what kind of position they are ({{P|31}}, {{P|279}}), which country they belong to ({{P|17}}) and which jurisdiction they apply to ({{P|1001}}). These batches add those statements to positions that are clearly tied to one country. Generic roles that exist in many countries (such as "minister" or "mayor") are left without a country.
; Person profiles
: People who hold such positions often lack {{P|39}} statements, or their dates of birth and death, place of birth or citizenship. These batches add those statements from the person's Wikipedia articles, with a reference to the article revision that states them. Where a statement already exists, the edit adds the missing dates or reference to it, or makes an imported date more precise.

Where the Wikipedia articles of office holders name a position that has no item yet, a batch named ''missing positions'' creates the position item first.

== How the edits are made ==
* Every edit is made through [[Wikidata:QuickStatements|QuickStatements]] and belongs to a batch, tracked as an [[Wikidata:Edit groups|edit group]], where a whole batch can be reviewed or undone.
* Statements read from a Wikipedia article carry a reference to that article ({{P|143}}, {{P|4656}}, {{P|813}}). Statements that follow from the structure of Wikidata itself, such as the country of a position, carry none.
* A statement sourced by someone else is never changed; only a date imported from Wikipedia without a source is made more precise. A value that conflicts with what an item already says is left alone.
* Before each batch, the items are read again live, so an edit someone else made in the meantime is respected.

== Problems ==
If an edit is wrong, please revert it and leave a note on [[User talk:Pudox]]. A statement removed as wrong is not added again, and the same class of mistake is fixed for later batches.
